title: Transportation
tagline: How the world started moving faster.
source: Generated from “Timeline of transportation technology” on Wikipedia; each event links to its source article.

events.title: Domestication of the horse
events.text: Domestication of the horse and invention of the wheel in Ancient Near East

events.title: Baghdad
events.text: The streets of Baghdad are paved with tar.

events.title: Adam Wybe
events.text: Adam Wybe builds world's first cable car on multiple supports. It was the biggest built until the end of the 19th century.

events.title: Jacques de Vaucanson
events.text: Jacques de Vaucanson debuted his clockwork powered carriage.

events.title: Joseph Montgolfier and Étienne Montgolfier
events.text: Joseph Montgolfier and Étienne Montgolfier launch the first hot air balloons triggering Balloonomania.

events.title: Francois Isaac de Rivaz
events.text: Francois Isaac de Rivaz – the De Rivaz engine, the first internal combustion engine using hydrogen as a fuel

events.title: George Stephenson
events.text: George Stephenson built the first practical steam-powered railway locomotive "Blutcher" at Killingworth Colliery.

events.title: Liverpool and Manchester Railway
events.text: Bill passed for Liverpool and Manchester Railway at second attempt and George Stephenson commences work on 35-mile twin track line permitting simultaneous travel in both directions between the 2 towns. Means of traction not specified to reduce opposi

events.title: Dalkey Atmospheric railway
events.text: Dalkey Atmospheric railway opens.

events.title: Étienne Lenoir
events.text: Étienne Lenoir made a gasoline engine automobile.

events.title: bogie
events.text: Midland railway introduces the first bogie.

events.title: Battery electric multiple unit
events.text: The first Battery electric multiple unit (battery rail car) was used on the Royal Bavarian State Railways.

events.title: trolleyboat
events.text: Frank W. Hawley adapted an ordinary steam canal boat to a trolleyboat (named after him), which was tested on the Erie Canal in the US.

events.title: Ferdinand von Zeppelin
events.text: Ferdinand von Zeppelin builds the first successful airship.

events.title: Bolzano
events.text: the Kohlerer-funicular went into service in Bolzano. It was the first modern (enclosed) cable car in the world to carry passengers.

events.title: autogyro
events.text: First controlled autogyro rotorcraft flight in Cierva C.4.

events.title: First fully articulated bus Isotta Fraschini TS40
events.text: First fully articulated bus Isotta Fraschini TS40.

references.label: Encyclopedia article: Timeline of transportation technology

events.title: Vostok 1
events.text: Vostok 1, first crewed space mission, designed by Sergey Korolyov, makes two orbits around the Earth with Yuri Gagarin.

events.title: Concorde
events.text: Concorde makes the world's first commercial passenger-carrying supersonic flight.

events.title: Channel Tunnel
events.text: Channel Tunnel opens.

events.title: folding electric bicycle
events.text: Honda Step Compo, first folding electric bicycle internationally available.

events.title: Metrocable (Medellín)
events.text: First modern urban transit aerial cable car Metrocable (Medellín).

events.title: Navya SAS
events.text: Navya SAS launch first autonomous bus, Navya Autonom Shuttle at Sheba Medical Center, Israel.

events.title: Autonomous Rail Rapid Transit
events.text: The Autonomous Rail Rapid Transit opens in China.

events.title: autonomous vessels
events.text: The world's first urban autonomous vessels, Roboats, are deployed in the canals of Amsterdam, Netherlands. The ships developed by three institutions could carry up to five people, collect waste, deliver goods, and provide "on-demand infrastructure".

events.title: Mini-Hollands
events.text: An analysis of Outer London's Mini-Hollands active transport infrastructures indicates Low Traffic Neighbourhoods are highly effective and cost-efficient measures in terms of health economic benefits.
